_note: Props a town is dressed with — wells, stalls, carts, barrels, fences, fields — built from LPC sheet cells by world/townProps.js and registered as editor objects (CustomObjects). 'rect' is [col, row, w, h] in 32px cells of the sheet; the bottom-left cell is the anchor. 'solid' is how many bottom rows block movement (0 = walk over). Names drive what you can do with them (a 'Barrel' or 'Crate' can be looked into, a 'Well' drawn from).

camps._doc: The tents a camp is pitched with (world/innerMap/camp.js): a clan's camp and a village of the Dawn of Man ('dawn'), a colony freshly founded in play ('colony'). Art: assets/lpc/Objects/Camp/Tents.png (scripts/make_tent_sheet.py).

_stallArtDoc: A market stall's look by its trade (world/marketStalls.js, data/marketStalls.json): over = goods on the counter, [sheet, col, row, atCol, atRow] — a 32px cell of a sheet drawn at a place of the stall (atCol 0..2 across, atRow up from its bottom row, fractions allowed), with an optional sixth, scale: the cell drawn that much smaller, stood on the bottom middle of its place, so a big sprite keeps to the counter; the stall carries them as a colour variant of tp_stall (customObject.colorVariantIdx). side = the props to stand beside it, one taking the place of the planner's side prop where it has the same footprint. A trade may wear other looks by what it has in stock (data/marketStalls.json artVariants): greengrocer_orchard after the fruit harvest, greengrocer_roots through the winter; new looks go at the end, since a stall's look is its place in this list.

fence.name: Fence
fence._gateDoc: A gate opens and shuts (world/townProps.js setGate; world/innerMap/gates.js): shut (cell) it blocks like the fence, open (the open cell: the leaf swung back against its left post) it is walked through. Gates stand shut; the player opens one from its menu or by walking into it, and it stays as they leave it (world.gates, saved); townsfolk open a shut gate as they pass and shut it behind them.
fence._joinDoc: Fence pieces joined by their neighbours (world/townProps.js joinFences): the ThatchedHouses fence sheet is a full set — each key names the sides (n, e, s, w) a cell has fence on, and its cell carries the rails out to just those sides, so corners, T-joins, crossings and run ends meet. gateLeft/gateRight are the run pieces either side of a gate, with its gateposts. The legacy h/v pieces above stay registered so old saves still draw until the town is entered.

_growthDoc: Town fields grow through the year (world/townProps.js growFields): each cycle is [dayOfYear, field kind] steps (Spring 1-30, Summer 31-60, Autumn 61-90, Winter 91-120); a field keeps the last step reached, a few days early or late by where it lies. Kinds not in a cycle (plowed: fallow land) stay as they are.
_harvestDoc: A ripe town field can be brought in (ui/innerMapFields.js): help the farmer for a share of the crop (workShare, hours by the field's size), or steal a handful at the theft odds (systems/containers.js). Its crop is perCell x cells; once it is all taken the field lies harvested (plowed) till the new year. goods: what a field of the kind may grow, one per field and year (a hash of the field's place and the year; good when it has no place).

felling._note: Trees felled on the inner map (world/innerMap/felling.js; player/gathering.js). Each tree's own fell block names its stump (left where it stood, sheet stumps_<season>.png, scripts/make_stump_sheet.py), its hardness (the def's resistance: % less a blow does, so a great oak takes more swings than a birch), wood (its log count when it is not a wild tree) and gives (more besides the logs: { item, qty [min, max], chance, seasons }). A stump's grub block is grubbing it out: hardness, firewood, gives. Felled trees are kept on world.felled[hex] (saved): the stump stands sproutDays, then a sapling (sapling, or palmSapling for a palm) grows there, a tree again treeDays after the felling; a stump grubbed out leaves the ground clear for good. fallSeconds: how long the tree takes to come down.
felling._hexTreesNote: Trees an inner map of each ground is drawn with (counted on generated maps, 2026-11-12: boreal ~440, woodland ~350-760, temperate rainforest ~420): a hex's stock for the Fell timber standing order (world/woodlands.js). Every felling on the hex (by hand, by the town's woodcutters, by the order) holds one back until it grows back (treeDays).

granary._note: Grain at a town's granary (ui/innerMapGranary.js): it sells from the town's food store, keeping back reserveDays of the people's needs, at priceMult of the market's ask, in these lots; it buys grain into the store at buyMult of the ask, as long as there is room (the store holds Economy.FOOD.stockDays of needs).
